# =============================================================================
# tessera-term: esctest subset + vttest menu 2 screen 13  (issue #15, wave 5)
# crates/tessera-term/tests/fixtures/esctest_spec.txt   (spec-researcher output)
#
# Same layout as csi_spec.txt (### ID / size / step / screen / cursor / pending_wrap / requests / scrollback), so
# tests/spec/mod.rs `parse_fixture(text)` reads it unchanged. Extra keys, all ignored by that parser:
#   source:       esctest file and function (E_* ids) or vttest function + capture (V2S13)
#   cite:         URL(s)
#   note:         what the esctest test does and what the row asserts
#   chunk:        yes|no. NOT needed: all 126 cases run whole AND byte by byte in 0.06 s (debug build). Documentation only.
#   attr:         (row,col0)-(row,col1) <pen>   0-based, inclusive; pen = sgr_spec.txt canonical text
#                 (fg=<c> bg=<c> ul=<c> us=<style> flags=<list>). Only E_SGR_bold and V2S13 have it. Cells not listed
#                 have the `attr_others:` pen. parse_fixture ignores these lines: esctest.rs must read them itself.
#   flags:        free text
# Lines starting `#>` are esctest tests that tessera-term cannot pass yet (NOT cases, never skipped tests); each names the
# issue that will make it pass: #8 (DECSET/DECOM/SM), #80 (DECSTR), #93 (HPR/VPR), #94 (SCOSC/SCORC), #95 (SPA/EPA and
# DEC protection), #96 (S7C1T/S8C1T, 8-bit C1), #97 (left/right margins DECLRMM/DECSLRM, DECSET 45 reverse wrap).
#
# HOW THE ROWS WERE PRODUCED  (tools/gen15.py, tools/model.py, tools/sec{1..4}.py, kept in the researcher scratch dir)
#   - Byte streams are transcribed from esctest2 (https://github.com/ThomasDickey/esctest2, esctest/tests/*.py) through the
#     helpers in esccmd.py, with esctest Point(x, y) turned into CUP row;col. V2S13 is the real vttest 2.7 (20251205) stream
#     captured under a pty (wave 3 capture m2_13.bin).
#   - Expected screens come from tools/model.py, an independent Python model of xterm (charproc.c/cursor.c/util.c), NOT from
#     tessera-grid. EVERY esctest assertion (cursor via DSR 6, characters via DECRQCRA, including intermediate ones) was
#     replayed on the model while generating: a mismatch aborts the generator. So each row equals what esctest asserts on xterm.
#   - Conformance probe: the whole file was run through spec::parse_fixture + spec::check_case (whole and byte by byte) on
#     main (e2fc473) in a scratch copy: 125 of 125 pass, the attr: lines match the real cell styles, and a corrupted copy of a
#     row is detected. The same probe over the 8 rows the researcher kept pending failed 8 of 8 there; on 17c5cf3 one of them passes (#80 merged)
#     and is live as E_DECRC_saveRestoreCursor_reset (126 cases now); the other 7 are in esctest_pending.txt.
#
# HOW esctest ASSERTIONS MAP TO THE FIXTURE
#   esctest reads the cursor with DSR 6 (needs #10) and the screen with DECRQCRA checksums; tessera tests read the grid. So:
#   GetCursorPosition() -> `cursor:` (and the `|` marker in `screen:`); AssertScreenCharsInRectEqual -> the `screen:` rows.
#   Only the FINAL state is asserted by the fixture; esctest's intermediate asserts are replayed by the generator.
#   Before every esctest test, esctest.py reset() puts the terminal in a known state; the fixture assumes the same on a fresh
#   Terminal: size 25x80 (reset() does XTWINOPS 8;25;80, so 25 rows x 80 cols, NOT 24x80), tab stops at 9, 17, ... (HTS every
#   8), DECAWM on, IRM and LNM off, no margins, cursor home, screen blank, pen default. empty() and blank() cells (NUL vs
#   space) are not distinguished by tessera.
#   vtLevel(4) tests are included (xterm and tessera are VT420+ in these areas); only the VT100-only ones are not special.
#
# ESCTEST QUIRKS KEPT VERBATIM
#   - esccmd.HVP(row=..)/(col=..)/() send `ESC[..H` (final 'H'), not 'f' (esccmd.py l.671-683). Only HVP(Point) uses 'f'.
#   - esccmd.SD sends final 'T' (CSI Ps T), SU sends 'S'. HPA is CSI ` (handled with CHA in csi.rs).
#   - The 7-bit forms are used (ESC D/E/H/M); the *_8bit tests need S8C1T (ESC SP G) and are `#>`.
#   - test_*_AfterNoWrappedInlines/AfterOneWrappedInline (CUB) depend on xterm's reverse-wrap patch level (>= 383).
#
# SOURCES
#   esctest2           https://github.com/ThomasDickey/esctest2  (esctest/tests/{cup,cuu,cud,cuf,cub,cha,vpa,hpa,hpr,vpr,hvp,
#                      cnl,cpl,ed,el,ech,ich,dch,il,dl,su,sd,rep,hts,tbc,cbt,cht,decstbm,ind,nel,ri,decaln,decrc,scorc,sgr,
#                      save_restore_cursor}.py, esctest.py reset(), esccmd.py, escio.py). 196 tests in these files: 125 are cases
#                      below, 71 are `#>` blocks (several tests may share one `#>` block; DECRC tests count once per class).
#                      The original is https://github.com/gnachman/esctest; esctest2 is the maintained fork xterm is tested with.
#   xterm ctlseqs      https://invisible-island.net/xterm/ctlseqs/ctlseqs.html
#   xterm source       https://github.com/ThomasDickey/xterm-snapshots (charproc.c, cursor.c, util.c, tabs.c; as csi_spec.txt)
#   vttest             https://invisible-island.net/vttest/ main.c tst_screen() (menu 2 screen 13)
#
# VTTEST MENU 1/2 SCREEN INVENTORY (real vttest 2.7 capture): menu 1 has SIX screens (m1_01..m1_06; m1_07 is the return to the
#   main menu), menu 2 has FIFTEEN (m2_01..m2_15). Already ported (csi_spec.txt): m1 1,5,6; m2 1,2,12. Of the rest only
#   menu 2 screen 13 (SGR pattern) needs no DECSET: it is the one vttest case below. Menu 1 screens 2,3,4 and menu 2 screens
#   3-11, 14, 15 need DECCOLM / DECOM / DECSCNM / SCS (#8) and are already `#### DEFERRED` blocks in csi_spec.txt.
#   There are no menu 1 screens 7-9.
# =============================================================================

#> E_CUB_stopsAtLeftEdgeWhenBegunLeftOfScrollRegion, E_CUB_stopsAtLeftMarginInScrollRegion -> #97 (DECLRMM + DECSLRM)

### V2S13_sgr_pattern
size: 24x80
step: feed \x1b[1;24r\x1b[2J\x1b[1;20HGraphic rendition test pattern:\x1b[4;1H\x1b[0mvanilla\x1b[4;40H\x1b[0;1mbold\x1b[6;6H\x1b[;4munderline\x1b[6;45H

source: vttest main.c tst_screen() screen 13 capture vttest_capture/m2_13.bin
cite: https://invisible-island.net/vttest/ (vttest 2.7 20251205, source https://invisible-island.net/archives/vttest/vttest.tar.gz) main.c tst_screen() 'Graphic rendition test pattern'
note: Eight lines x two columns of SGR 0/1/4/5/7 combinations (vanilla, bold, underline, bold underline, blink, bold blink, ..., bold underline blink negative). `ESC[;4m` = [0,4] (reset then underline): empty parameters are 0. The row-16 left entry sends `1;4;;5;7`: the empty third parameter RESETS, so only blink+inverse survive although the label says 'blink negative' (the label is what vttest means; xterm applies the reset: xterm charproc.c CASE_SGR param 0 / -1 default). `ESC[?5l` (DECSCNM reset) and `ESC[1;24r` appear: the first is ignored (CSI with intermediate), the second sets the full-screen region and homes. Final line 23: 'Dark background. Push <RETURN>' with the default pen.
